test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In the state assembly elections held in February - March 2022, the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) formed the government in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab.**__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Aam Aadmi Party** is a political party in India.
 
• The AAP is currently the ruling party of two governments: Delhi, the capital territory of India, and the state of Punjab.
 
• The **Aam Aadmi Party Punjab** or **AAP Punjab** is the Punjab state wing of Aam Aadmi Party and a recognised state party in Punjab.
 
• It has members in the Punjab Legislative Assembly and Rajya Sabha 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Aam Aadmi Party gained a strong 79% majority in the** sixteenth Punjab Legislative Assembly** by winning 92 out of 117 seat
 
• AAP Punjab convener and **MP Bhagwant Mann **was sworn in as Chief Minister.
